full_tool_collection.name: comprehensive_rail_trip_planner
full_tool_collection.description: An all-in-one tool for planning multi-day rail trips. It automatically determines the current date, finds the optimal train stations for the given cities, queries for round-trip tickets with real-time pricing and schedules, and generates a complete daily itinerary including budget estimates. This tool is designed to replace multiple separate calls like 'get-current-date', 'get-station-code-of-citys', and 'get-tickets', providing a more efficient and integrated solution for complex travel planning.
